scope: Two-domain architecture experiment, not broad-domain replacement training. All branches train the encoder and randomly initialized tag head end to end. No SigLIP2 weights enter FoveaTag.

throughput.measurement_limit: Short steady-state measurement with synthetic labels; startup, long-run storage stalls, and validation require additional time. Not a tag-quality measurement.

data.snapshot_method: SQLite online backup from the owner database; no database mutations propagate into the comparison.
data.photo_supervision: Existing partially curated positives are retained; unverified fine-detail negatives are masked using the registered fine-detail vocabulary. No eye-specific routing or sampling.

training.loss: Existing masked asymmetric loss, global batch-by-tag mean
training.budget_policy: Identical shared initialization, sampling seed, data, schedule, and sample/update budget across all three branches; no quality-driven budget change within this comparison.

evaluation.runner: core.tagger.foveatag.phase3_evaluation; all manifest resolutions, after comparison_summary.status is complete
evaluation.requirement: Generate all three branch predictions on both registered benchmark resolution ladders; compare C with compute-matched B and overview-only A and the untouched fixed-384 baseline. Report photo provenance limitations separately from illustration ground results.
evaluation.gate: Explicit repository-owner Phase 3 decision under the existing design criteria after all evidence is available. This plan introduces no post-hoc numeric threshold.
evaluation.next_scope: Production replacement also requires broad semantic-domain coverage and evaluation of every omitted domain. This experiment cannot be presented as matching all 16 domains of the existing tagger.
